lead: Unwind without the fog. A blackberry gummy that brings together reishi — the ancient 'mushroom of calm' — with L-theanine and soothing botanicals like lemon balm, passion flower and valerian, to ease stress and bring a sense of balance to your day.

science.title: Reishi, the adaptogen for balance
science.text: Reishi has been called the 'mushroom of immortality' in traditional medicine — an adaptogen prized for helping the body cope with stress and find balance. We pair 200 mg of reishi with a calming botanical stack — L-theanine, lemon balm, passion flower and valerian — so you get gentle, layered relaxation without the heaviness of a sedative.

format.title: Calm you can chew
format.text: No earthy mushroom tea, no pills. A soft blackberry gummy, sweetened with real fruit, that makes your daily moment of calm something to look forward to.

absorb.title: Layered, gentle calm
absorb.lead: Reishi helps your body adapt to stress, while L-theanine and calming herbs quiet a busy mind — together, balance without drowsiness.

points.title: Reishi adaptogen
points.text: An adaptogenic mushroom that helps the body cope with stress and return to balance.

points.title: L-theanine focus-calm
points.text: The amino acid from green tea that brings a relaxed, focused calm — not sleepiness.

points.title: Soothing herbal trio
points.text: Lemon balm, passion flower and valerian — three classic botanicals for easing tension and winding down.

facts.warning: Contains valerian — may cause drowsiness; do not drive or operate machinery until you know how it affects you. If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, taking sedatives or other medication, or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: Chew one gummy
steps.text: Take 1 gummy daily — no water needed.

steps.title: When you need to unwind
steps.text: Have it in the late afternoon or evening, or whenever stress is running high.

steps.title: Mind the valerian
steps.text: Because it contains valerian, it can be calming enough that you'll want to avoid driving right after — especially in the evening.

series.label: Calm
series.title: Less on edge
series.text: Reishi and calming botanicals were associated with feeling calmer and more resilient to everyday stress over the programme.

series.label: Balance
series.title: More even, more grounded
series.text: As an adaptogen, reishi tracked with a steadier mood and a greater sense of balance through ups and downs.

series.label: Unwind
series.title: Easier to switch off
series.text: L-theanine, passion flower and valerian were linked with winding down more easily and more restful evenings.

items.a: Reishi is an adaptogenic mushroom — it helps your body cope with stress and return to balance. It's traditionally used to promote calm and a steady, grounded feeling.
It's designed for calm rather than sedation, but it does contain valerian, so some people feel relaxed enough to sleep — which is why we suggest the afternoon or evening.

items.q: Can I take it for sleep?
items.a: Many people use it in the evening to wind down. The valerian and passion flower in particular support a restful, easier transition to sleep.
Yes — it's a pectin gummy with no gelatin, coloured and flavoured with real blackberry.

If you're pregnant or nursing, under 18, taking sedatives or other medication, or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use. Avoid driving right after taking it until you know how it affects you.
